name: review-lessons
description: Library of lessons from past build-review loops — not a stage. Use when a review or fix round hits a specific case: a reviewer BLOCKING that contradicts the brief, a test that passes but checks nothing, a feature dead in production, SQLite/WAL migrations, MCP tool surfaces, REST API authz, app ↔ external-source sync, Android/APK verification, fill-template extraction, CLI/git mechanics, reviewer outages. Load the one file the case needs; never load the whole library.
